player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id}. Yu i pley Guess The Number.
Yu mas guesim nembr i go long {min_number} na {max_number} inside long {max_turns} turn.
Olsem yu putim yu gues, gem i save givim yu hint olsem 'higher' o 'lower'.
Yu ken givim bek yu tok long eni kain. Nembr i stap inside skwea brakets tasol bai ol i kisim olsem yu gues. Olsem, [5].
Olsem yu pley, stori bilong yu gues bai ol i stap daunbo. Yu usim infomesen ya kompletim gem bifo yu ron out of gues.
Putim yu gues.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pasin bilong go i no stret. Pleya {player_id} i no tokim namba bilong go stret long '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Move i no stret. Pela {player_id} i guess namba i go ausait long namba i tok.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Move i no stret. Pela {player_id} i guess namba i bin guess pinis.

game_message.target_higher: Namba bilong ol man em i laik kilim, dispela namba i bikpela moa.
game_message.target_lower: Namba bilong ol man em i laik kilim, i go daun.

outcome.win: Gutpela tru, yu ting namba i stret.
outcome.turn_limit: Taim bilong guess i pinis. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
